artworks.title: L'abside de Notre-Dame de Paris (The Apse ofthe Cathedral of Notre-Dame, Paris)
artworks.description: This etching depicts Notre-Dame Cathedral in the distance, featuring its recognizable twin towers and flying buttresses. The horizon line is low, emphasizing the cathedral's height. A bridge connects the cathedral to the land in the foreground. The scene is detailed with fine lines, showing the architectural elements and riverbank activities. The color palette is monochromatic, typical of etchings. Boats and figures, including a horse-drawn cart, are seen near the riverbank.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Two Sphinxes and Two  Children Holding Palms
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: The image is a vertical, rectangular design featuring a series of symmetrical shapes and intricate lines. The composition includes an abstract arrangement of flowing and swirling shapes with ornamental details. At the top, two animals stand facing each other. Below them, two cherub-like figures support a central pedestal, topped with a vase filled with leaves and tendrils. Lower down, there is a large symmetrical design featuring a central shield-like shape flanked by scrolls and stylized leaves. The entire composition resembles an ornate architectural panel or decorative frieze.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Two Sphinxes Supporting Shields
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: The image is an elongated, vertically oriented decorative panel with intricate scrollwork, floral motifs, and mythological figures. The upper section features symmetrical patterns resembling an ornate vase with floral elements. The central section displays a detailed botanical-inspired arrangement of leaves and flowers. The lower section shows two winged mythological creatures with human faces and bird features facing each other, with two cherubic figures above them holding onto an oval frame or medallion surrounded by floral designs. The overall style of the piece is classical and baroque.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Triton and Two Infant Satyrs
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling lines and intricate shapes in an abstract vertical pattern. At the top, there is a bird with outstretched wings surrounded by curling tendrils and foliage motifs. Cherubic figures with musical instruments are integrated into the design, among vines and floral decorations. In the middle, an ornate vase-like structure is adorned with circular floral patterns. Near the bottom, two figures with full beards hold instruments.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Four Children with a Cat and a Dog
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental vertical panel featuring intricate designs and cherubs. The panel includes symmetrical ornamental motifs with cherubic figures at the top and bottom. In the center, there are large vases filled with an elaborate arrangement of plant forms, scrolling acanthus leaves, and classical ornamentation. The panel is detailed with seamless transitions between sections through curling forms and decorative flourishes. The style suggests classical influences, emphasizing symmetry and design harmony typical of Renaissance decorative arts.

artworks.title: Victor Hugo
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed drawing of a man from the shoulders up with a neutral expression. The man has short dark hair slicked to the sides and wears a formal attire with a high, white shirt collar under a dark garment. The drawing is surrounded by elaborate architectural elements inspired by gothic style, resembling miniature cathedrals and sculptures with smaller human figures depicted in various poses and activities. Some sections are labeled with names or titles such as "CROMWEL" and "VICTOR HUGO". The overall structure resembles a cathedral façade with multiple small scenes and characters. The background is a plain, light color that enhances the intricate detailing and dark shading of the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Bug-Jargal
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed illustration of various figures and scenes surrounding a central figure. The central figure is a man standing confidently with one hand on his hip and holding a large flag or sail in the other hand. He wears historic-style clothing. The border is filled with intricate drawings of animals, scenes from a tropical forest, human figures, and an ancient castle-like structure. The text "BUG-JARGAL" and "Publié par Eugène Renduel" are inscribed at the bottom of the print.

artworks.title: Notre-Dame de Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural façade with elements of Gothic design and ornamentation. It features a vertical structure with multiple sections resembling carvings found on a Gothic cathedral. Small figures and scenes are depicted in niches like statuary. The lower portion includes illustrations of narrative scenes enhanced by arches and motifs, connecting different stories. The texture shows a rich interplay of light and shadow, emphasizing the design complexity, similar to the style of Notre-Dame de Paris.

artworks.title: Le dernier jour d'un condamne
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man sitting inside a room. The drawing contains a central rectangular frame with a seated man staring outward. Surrounding the central figure are chaotic scenes depicting various figures in different states of motion and interaction. Some figures appear distressed or animated, with others in elevated positions suggestive of a courtroom-like setting. The drawing creates an atmosphere of tension and drama, with dynamic lines and shading adding to the emotional intensity. The text "Le Dernier Jour d’un Condamné" is prominent.

artworks.title: Lace appraiser (L'Experte en Dentelles)
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman sitting in a chair. She is facing to the right and has a gentle expression. She wears a lace headpiece and a dark garment. She holds sewing materials in her hands. The background includes a window with drawn drapes and a potted plant on a windowsill. The setting has a warm and domestic feel.

artworks.title: Title Page (Le Titre)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page with the text "PREMIER ESSAI DE PAPILLONERIES HUMAINES." The frame surrounding the text is intricate and features fabric, floral motifs, and ornamental patterns. The central area is left blank, with embellishments creating texture. A symbol resembling a butterfly or moth is at the top center of the page. The drawing emphasizes decorative arts with careful attention to detail.

artworks.title: Le Bain (The Bath)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed abstract composition with curved lines, a central boat-like figure with masts and sail-like cloths adorned with floral arrangements, butterfly-like shapes with humanoid figures on the sides, and a decorative base with scrolls and floral motifs encapsulating banners and the text "LE BAIN".

artworks.title: Le Bateleur (The Street Performer)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed scene with a large butterfly at the center, another butterfly below it, an ornate chair with a goblet to the right, and part of a violin to the left among foliage. A horizontal ladder connects the chair to the foreground. The drawing is in monochrome, with shades of brown and beige, giving it a vintage aesthetic. It features a blend of natural and crafted elements gathered in a whimsical design, with central butterflies holding prominent positions bridging elements with connecting lines.

artworks.title: Le Blessé (The Wounded)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of anthropomorphic insects on a platform. The drawing depicts three anthropomorphic butterflies carrying a fourth insect, which appears to be a moth, on a stretcher-like device. Two butterflies are at each end of the stretcher, walking with their small legs, while the moth lies in the middle with wings spread and looks as though it is resting or unconscious. Above, a smaller insect is floating in the air, holding onto an umbrella. The platform on which this scene occurs is detailed with foliage and beards, and it sits suspended in space. The drawing is rendered in fine lines, with attention to the delicate textures of the wings and the organic shapes of the landscape.

artworks.title: Le Damier (The Checkerboard)
artworks.description: The image shows two butterflies playing chess. The butterflies have intricate wings and are on opposite sides of a raised chessboard on a detailed pedestal. Below the pedestal are stylized leaves and floral elements, and the background has a patterned screen. The scene combines whimsical nature with a classic game, reminiscent of historical illustrative art.

artworks.title: La Brouette (The Paltry Coach)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two anthropomorphic butterflies transporting a wheeled canopy cart on a naturalistic platform. The drawing features two butterflies with human-like torsos standing on their hind limbs. They are facing each other while holding the handles of the cart, which is centered between them. The cart has wheels and is topped with a canopy under which a small creature can be seen peeking out. The scene rests on a platform resembling a tree branch or ledge adorned with greenery and tendrils. Below this ledge, there are decorative florals and stylized root-like structures, with "LA BROUETTE" inscribed at the bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: Title Page (Le Titre)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed irregularly to and within plate mark): 32.2 x 24.5 cm (12 11/16 x 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays intricate and swirling lines forming an elongated triangular shape at the center. There are elegantly detailed butterflies scattered throughout. The surrounding area contains delicate, flowing lines reminiscent of plants or vines. At the base, there are cloud-like formations. The central structure is inscribed with text.

artworks.title: Théâtre Italien (Italian Theater)
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate stage with moth-like figures with wings. The stage is intricately decorated with floral and foliage elements arching above to create a canopy effect. In the center, two insect figures with large wings appear to be performing a dance. The wings are detailed with patterns resembling moth or butterfly wings. Surrounding the stage, decorative motifs include leaves, flowers, and scroll-like shapes, suggesting a lush garden. A banner at the bottom reads "THEATRE ITALIEN." The image showcases intricate linework and careful craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Ballet Champêtre (Country Ballet)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts anthropomorphic butterflies dancing under a floral and vine archway. Three butterflies with humanoid features are shown posing gracefully, while another butterfly plays a musical instrument. The archway above them is made of twisted vines and leaves, creating a stage-like setting. The base of the image features organic shapes and patterns around a scroll with the text "Ballet Champêtre." The style is ornate and delicate, typical of the Rococo period.

artworks.title: Le Duel (The Duel)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.1 x 23.7 cm (13 1/16 x 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of anthropomorphic butterflies engaged in a duel with fencing swords. The butterflies have human-like bodies with wings resembling cloaks or capes. They stand on an ornate structure featuring decorative architectural elements like columns with floral and leaf motifs. Above them are arches, canopies, and hanging vines, creating a theatrical setting. The drawing combines fantasy and nature elements, showcasing elegance and imagination.

artworks.title: Théâtre Français (French Theater)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical stage with insect-headed, butterfly-winged figures. The drawing shows an ornate stage setting labeled "THEATRE FRANÇOIS" with intricate architectural and natural elements, such as a large spider web forming the backdrop and vines adorning the space. Two figures, each with human bodies, butterfly wings, and insect heads, are positioned as if performing on a platform bordered by decorative columns. The design is elaborate and displays a blend of fantasy and elegance, typical of Rococo art, with detailed embellishments and a sense of whimsy.

artworks.title: La Toilette
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.2 x 23.8 cm (13 1/16 x 9 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of butterfly-like creatures in a surreal setting. The scene features two large butterfly-like figures on ornate furniture, surrounded by elaborate scrollwork. In the background, a small creature with person-like body and insect wings is engaged in an activity. The drawing includes detailed lines and objects like books and furniture with intricate patterns. There is also a sign that reads "LA TOILETTE" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Laban cherchant ses dieux (Laban Searching for his Household Gods)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering of people in a biblical or historical setting. The scene depicts several individuals beneath a tent-like canopy. To the center-left, a woman sits with an infant on her lap, surrounded by other figures in flowing robes. To the right, a figure stands authoritatively, gesturing as if speaking or giving instructions. The detailed etching captures the texture of the fabrics and expressions of the figures, with shading and cross-hatching used to create depth and dimension. The scene is composed with a balance of horizontal and vertical elements, drawing the viewer's eye across the assembly of figures and objects on the ground.

artworks.title: Reconciliation of Absalom and David (Réconciliation d'Absalom et de David)
artworks.medium: etching reworked in graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene featuring a regal figure in an ornate interior. The image includes opulent drapery and architectural elements like columns and arches. In the center, a seated figure is wearing a cape that suggests authority. Around them, other figures are interacting, with one figure kneeling in front of the main subject. The figures are depicted with intricate linework, emphasizing the texture and grandeur of the scene. Chiaroscuro is used to highlight the drama and gravity of the moment depicted.
